Container.Name: neos-headless
Container.Overview:
This Docker will download and install SteamCMD. It will also install neos (headless) and run it.
ATTENTION: First Startup may take a moment as it downloads the gameserver files!
Update Notice: Simply restart the container if a newer version of the game is available.
You can also run multiple servers with only one SteamCMD directory!
Container.Requires:
[ ! --- READ ME --- ! ]
No ports/port forwarding needed!
As of the updating of this docker template, you must be a patreon member of neos with at least the Gunter teir support ($12 per month) | https://www.patreon.com/neosvr/membership
Steam login and the headless beta password are not published in this template. After install, add two variables locally: STEAMLOGIN (USERNAME then a space then PASSWORD) and STEAMBETAPASSWORD (from #headless-client pinned messages). Use a dedicated Steam account with Steam Guard off.
You must first make a Config.json file, create a new file naming it "Config.json" w/ capital "C". This file will need to be placed in your neos-headless config file location directory which you will define below.
An example of the Config.json file can be found in the discord pinned messages in #headless-client (https://discord.com/channels/402159838827905024/619845139770376192)

Config.Name: Config File Location
Config.Description: This is the path for neos-headless server files.

Config.Name: Logs
Config.Description: This is the log file location for neos-headless server logs.

Config.Name: GAME_ID
Config.Description: The GAME_ID that the container download at startup. (https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/Dedicated_Servers_List)

Config.Name: Steam Beta Version
Config.Description: headless-client | For more options, visit: https://wiki.neos.com/Headless_Client -AND/OR- https://discord.com/channels/402159838827905024/619845139770376192

Config.Name: Validate Installation
Config.Description: Set the Variable to 'true' if you want to validate the installation otherwise leave it blank.

Config.Name: Host Local Time Injected to Container
Config.Description: This pulls your local timezone file from UNRAID to manage the neos-headless server timezone. | Recommended read-only.
